title: Terms — CSOAI
description: CSOAI terms of use: what you can rely on (the measurement), what you cannot (a certification), and what we are not.
text: Terms — CSOAI Home Products Docs FAQ Terms of use By using csoai.org or CSOAI services you agree to these terms. They are short on purpose. What CSOAI is CSOAI Ltd is a UK company (16939677) that publishes measurement harnesses and signed results. We are a measurement body. We publish: Benchmarks (GovBench, ProvBench, AI Act frozen-split harness) Signed attestation records (Article 50 passports, living attestation) Developer APIs (leaderboard, registry, evaluate, signup) What CSOAI is not Not a certification body. We do not issue accreditations. Not a regulator. We do not enforce the EU AI Act or any other law. Not a notified body. Where the law requires a notified body, you need one. Not legal counsel. Nothing on this site is legal advice. What you can rely on Measurements — figures on a published harness, with stated method and confidence interval, signed with our public key. Signed records — Ed25519 signatures verifiable against the public key in /.well-known/agent.json . Recompute — every published figure can be reproduced from the published harness. If you can't, we have a bug; tell us. What you cannot rely on Any number on this site for a system other than the one tested. Any "pass / fail" claim that is not tied to a measurement and a harness. Any statement that a system is "compliant" — that is a regulator's call. Acceptable use Do not scrape the API faster than documented rate limits. Do not republish benchmark items verbatim to evade the harness. Do not impersonate CSOAI in a way that suggests certification. Liability To the maximum extent permitted by law, CSOAI is not liable for any decision you take on the basis of a measurement, signed record, or any other material on this site. Our maximum aggregate liability is the amount you paid us in the 12 months preceding the claim. Governing law England and Wales. Disputes in the courts of England and Wales. Contact Email legal@csoai.org . CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
